summary: Post-market read: total risk score 45.56, up 0.70 on the day, risk level still caution and the regime still goldilocks. The session was an oil-driven risk-off day: Brent settled at 107.63 dollars, up 6.34%, and WTI settled at 102.48 dollars, up 6.69%, pushing the FedWatch implied rate to 4.03 and pointing to a hike. AI and semiconductor growth names took the heaviest hit: AI infrastructure fell 3.12%, data centers 3.11% and semiconductor equipment 2.61%, while MU dropped 4.36%, AMD 3.03% and NVDA 2.35%. Volatility rose from 15.72 to 16.46, the 10-year real rate at 2.43 still sits at the 98.72 percentile, and the macro block at 61.62 remains the largest source of risk.

top_risk_drivers.claim: An oil shock dominated the session: Brent settled at 107.63 dollars, up 6.34%, and WTI at 102.48 dollars, up 6.69%, while the market-implied odds of a Fed hike next week rose to 70% and the FedWatch implied rate of 4.03 sits above the 3.63 effective fed funds rate, repricing the policy path toward a hike.

The macro block at 61.62 remains the largest risk source: the 10-year nominal yield at 4.80 sits at the 99.04 percentile and the 10-year real rate at 2.43 at the 98.72 percentile, with the 2-year at 4.39.

AI and semiconductor growth names led the decline: AI infrastructure fell 3.12%, data centers 3.11%, semiconductor equipment 2.61% and memory 2.50%, while at the single-stock level MU dropped 4.36%, AMD 3.03% and NVDA 2.35%.

Market breadth weakened alongside: the 52-week new-high ratio was only 0.65%, the new-low ratio 6.45% and the share above the 200-day moving average 56.77%, with semiconductor relative strength down at -8.53.

Cross-asset confirmation printed 0.75, the largest single risk contribution of the day at 7.50, as oil, rates and risk assets moved in the same direction, with the dollar index at 118.07 in the 15.49 percentile.

supporting_signals.claim: Inflation is still cooling underneath: headline CPI at 3.30% year over year versus 3.46% prior, core CPI at 2.47% versus 2.57%, and the 5-year breakeven at 2.33%.
Labor stayed firm: payrolls at 162 versus 21 prior, the unemployment rate at 4.10%, initial claims at 206000 and the participation rate at 61.6%.
Credit stayed broadly stable: high-yield spreads at 2.71% and investment-grade at 0.81%, with SOFR at 3.64%.

contradicting_signals.claim: Volatility rose but remains low in absolute terms: VIX moved from 15.72 to 16.46 and realized volatility sits at only 8.53.
The regime is still goldilocks: the total score of 45.56 sits inside the caution band and rose only 0.70 on the day, with model confidence at 0.92.
The trend dimension remains positive: price sits 6.19% above the 200-day moving average, only 2.57% below its 52-week high, with 3-month momentum at 4.47%.

what_changed_today: Total risk score rose to 45.56, up 0.70 on the day.
Crude settlements jumped: Brent at 107.63 dollars (+6.34%) and WTI at 102.48 dollars (+6.69%).
The FedWatch implied rate rose to 4.03 and points to a hike, with hike odds up to 70%.
AI infrastructure fell 3.12% and data centers 3.11%, with MU down 4.36% and AMD down 3.03%.
VIX rose from 15.72 to 16.46 and the 10-year nominal yield at 4.80 reached the 99.04 percentile.
watch_next: The CPI release on 2026-09-11 will test whether the oil shock feeds into inflation expectations.
Watch the FOMC meeting and its pricing window, alongside the retail sales release on 2026-09-16.
Watch the stickiness of core PCE at 3.34% and core CPI at 2.47%, and whether the 10-year real rate at 2.43 can ease.
Watch for further escalation in energy prices and geopolitics, and for drawdown risk in high-multiple growth names.
Watch the ADBE (2026-09-10) and FDX (2026-09-17) earnings.

bull_case.title: Bull case: oil retreats and CPI undershoots, pulling the real rate lower
points: If CPI undershoots and oil retreats from its highs, the 10-year real rate could ease from 2.43 and the total score could fall back below 45.

base_case.title: Base case: goldilocks holds, total score oscillates in a 45 to 50 band
points: An oil premium and policy uncertainty offset each other, VIX stays below 20 and the total score oscillates between 45 and 50.

bear_case.title: Bear case: oil holds its highs and a hike lands, pushing the total score above 55
points: If crude holds its highs and the Fed delivers a hike, the 10-year nominal yield could break above 5.00 and a drawdown in high-multiple AI and semiconductor names would push the total score above 55.
